notes.title: Game Update v5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Peninsular War Battles - version 3.1.1 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Change: The bonus 'To Arms!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
[*] Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.
[/list]

notes.title: Peninsular War Battles - version 3.1.0 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Weapon animations.
[*] Change: A reduction in the download size.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Update the play balance in some scenarios.
[*] Fix: A critical issue displaying the curved loss meters after the previous graphics update.
[*] Fix: An issue with some load/reload animations not displaying. This could give the impression that a unit was not firing.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons.
[*] Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: The in-game player message were sometimes cropped at the left edge of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update.

Change: Game performance is much faster and graphical execution smoother.
Add: Game Speed options in Settings General which includes 3 settings Standard, Slow and Fast.
Fix: Improved memory management.
Fix: Improved hex tile Positioning accuracy.
Change: Some UI updates.
Change: Reduced the length of some melee and shoot animations.

Any issues please let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue were a unit within rough ground could be forced into a square and become unresponsive.

Any issues please let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Add: A whole new way to play, 'Historical Mode'. This is now an option on starting a new mission.
Add: Change log for all updates in the latest edition of the game.
Add: Change log to the help menu.

notes.title: Hip to be (not in) square (formation...)
notes.content:
Hello all,

Apologies for the awful pun above!  We've just updated Peninsular War Battles to fix a couple of minor issues.
[list][*] Fix infantry units from forming square when charged by units other than cavalry.
[*] Fix movement rules when entering and leaving bridge hexes.[/list]
We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but please let us know at support@hexwar.com if anyone is having any problems, or has suggestions for improvements.  Thanks!

~ The HexWar Games Team.

notes.title: First patch out!
notes.content:
Good news!

We’ve just released a small patch for Peninsular War Battles that should fix the CTD issue some users have been experiencing.  Apologies for the frustration this has caused!  We hope everyone is enjoying the game, but please let us know of any issues or ideas for the future.

~ The HexWar Games Team
